sizeGuide.metaDescription: BADYSS size guide — how to measure yourself, choose your fit, from S to plus sizes.
sizeGuide.title: Size guide
sizeGuide.subtitle: BADYSS dresses every body — from classic sizes to plus sizes. Here's how to find yours.
sizeGuide.measureChestDetail: Measure horizontally around the widest part of the chest.
sizeGuide.measureWaistDetail: Measure around the natural waist, at its narrowest point.
sizeGuide.measureHipsDetail: Measure around the widest part of the hips.
sizeGuide.tip1: Measure yourself in underwear or thin clothing, for an accurate result.
sizeGuide.tip2: If unsure between two sizes, go up a size for more comfort.
sizeGuide.tip3: Stretch fabrics (jersey, knit) leave a little more room than rigid ones.
sizeGuide.tip4: Retake your measurements every 6 to 12 months — the body changes, and so does the right size.
sizeGuide.fitBody: Our pieces are designed for a comfortable drape, without being overly fitted — a silhouette that moves freely, from everyday wear to going out.
sizeGuide.grandesTaillesBody: Plus sizes are a genuine priority of the collection, not a late addition — same cuts, same fabrics, designed from the start for every body.

sizeGuide.faqQ1: What if I'm between two sizes?
sizeGuide.faqA1: Go up a size for more comfort, especially for non-stretch fabrics.
sizeGuide.faqQ2: Do BADYSS sizes match standard sizes?
sizeGuide.faqA2: Yes — the collection follows a standard progression (S to 4XL), with plus sizes designed from the start, not added later.
sizeGuide.faqQ3: Can I exchange if the size doesn't fit?
sizeGuide.faqA3: Yes — check our Returns page for the process.

cookies.intro: This page describes the cookies and similar technologies used by the BADYSS website, and how you can manage them.
cookies.whatIsContent: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when you visit a website. It allows the site to recognize your browser and remember certain information from one visit to the next. The BADYSS website also uses similar technologies (browser local storage, or "localStorage") for the same memorization purposes, without going through a cookie in the strict sense.
cookies.essentialIntro: These elements are strictly necessary for the Site to function and cannot be disabled without impairing the corresponding features. On badyss.com, these are exclusively local storage (localStorage), never transmitted to a third-party server:
cookies.essentialItem1: Your shopping cart contents, to keep it between visits;
cookies.essentialItem4: Your recent searches on the Site;
cookies.essentialItem5: Whether you've already seen the welcome popup, so it isn't shown again unnecessarily.
cookies.analyticsContent: As of today, the Site does not use any audience-measurement cookie or tool (such as Google Analytics or equivalent) and does not place any advertising cookie. Should such a tool be introduced, this section would be updated to describe it precisely and, where applicable, obtain your consent beforehand.
cookies.preferenceContent: Some local storage elements remember your display or interaction preferences with the Site (for example, closing a window or a filter's state). These elements fall under the same essential local storage described above and are used for no other purpose.
cookies.managementContent: You can clear the data stored locally by the Site at any time from your browser settings (browsing history / site data). This will reset your cart, wishlist and saved preferences. You can also configure your browser to block any cookie or local storage, at the risk of limiting certain Site features (cart, wishlist).
cookies.consentContent: Since the essential local storage described above is necessary for the Site to function (cart, wishlist), it does not require prior consent. Should non-essential cookies (audience measurement, advertising) be introduced in the future, a clear consent banner would let you accept or decline them before any are placed.

privacy.intro: This page explains how BADYSS collects, uses and protects your personal data when you use our Site.
privacy.introBody1: BADYSS ("we", "our", "us") attaches great importance to protecting the privacy of people who visit and use the badyss.com website (the "Site"). This privacy policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we use it, and what rights you can exercise over it.
privacy.introBody2: This policy applies to anyone visiting the Site, creating an account, placing an order, or contacting us. It is written in accordance with the principles of Law No. 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, applicable in Morocco, and draws on international data-protection standards (including the European GDPR) as good practice.
privacy.dataCollectedIntro: We only collect the data necessary for the Site and our services to function, including:
privacy.dataCollectedItem1: first name, last name, email address, phone number, shipping address, provided when placing an order or via the contact form.
privacy.dataCollectedItem2: products ordered, sizes, amounts, purchase history.
privacy.dataCollectedItem3: pages viewed, wishlist, searches made on the Site, stored locally in your browser (see the Cookies section).
privacy.dataCollectedItem4: device type, browser, IP address, for security purposes and to ensure the Site functions properly.
privacy.dataCollectedClosing: We never collect banking data directly: any online payment, once activated, will be processed by a secure third-party payment provider and not stored by BADYSS.
privacy.dataUseIntro: Your personal data is used exclusively to:
privacy.dataUseItem1: Process, prepare and deliver your orders;
privacy.dataUseItem2: Respond to your requests via the contact form, by phone or WhatsApp;
privacy.dataUseItem4: Improve the Site's functioning and usability;
privacy.dataUseItem5: Inform you of our news and updates, only if you have consented to it (newsletter signup);
privacy.dataUseItem6: Ensure Site security and prevent fraud.
privacy.dataUseClosing: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. Your data is only shared with providers strictly necessary to perform our services (carrier for delivery, Site host).
privacy.cookiesContentPrefix: The Site uses cookies and similar technologies to ensure it functions properly and to improve your experience. Details of the cookie categories used, and how to manage your preferences, are available on our
privacy.retentionIntro: We keep your personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected:
privacy.retentionItem1: Data related to an order is kept for as long as necessary to manage it, then archived in accordance with applicable accounting and tax obligations.
privacy.retentionItem2: Contact data (form, with no associated order) is kept for as long as needed to process your request, then deleted or anonymized.
privacy.retentionItem3: Browsing data stored locally (wishlist, search history) stays on your device and can be cleared at any time from your browser.
privacy.securityContent: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration or disclosure. Access to data is limited to those who need it for their duties. As no system is foolproof, we also encourage you to adopt good practices (strong passwords, vigilance against phishing attempts).
privacy.rightsIntro: In accordance with applicable regulations, you have the following rights over your personal data:
privacy.rightsItem1: Right of access to your data;
privacy.rightsItem2: Right of rectification in case of inaccurate or incomplete data;
privacy.rightsItem3: Right of erasure of your data, within the limits provided by law (accounting obligations in particular);
privacy.rightsItem4: Right to object to the use of your data for marketing purposes;
privacy.rightsItem5: Right to withdraw your consent at any time, when processing depends on it (newsletter, for example).
